text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Amazing! That's wonderful, Trainer!
I'm amazed you managed to get so many.
choice_data_list: Our room's gonna be even livelier now!
Our room's going to be even livelier now!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
You worked this hard just for that?
...Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Numbers aren't everything, of course,
but anyone would be thrilled
to have this much done for them!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I can enjoy a party mood
even while staying in my room♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, this is starting to get fun.
Since we're here,
why don't we stop by a cafe on the way back?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Of course it's my treat.
Order whatever you like, whether it's cake or a parfait♪
